## LendLoop: error handler
Select this as the Error workflow of the other two LendLoop workflows. When one fails after its retries, this logs the error and reports it to LendLoop, where it shows on the Admin page. If the report itself fails, the run stays failed in n8n's execution list.

**Set on the n8n server:** `CONVEX_SITE_URL`, `CONVEX_TO_N8N_SECRET`, `N8N_TO_CONVEX_SECRET`, `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`, `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` (see the README).
